description: This file defines the class `NoteViewHolderWithExcerpt`, a custom ViewHolder used in an Android RecyclerView to display note items with an associated excerpt. It extends `NoteViewHolder` and manages UI elements related to individual note presentation, swipe actions, and search highlighting.

classes.name: NoteViewHolderWithExcerpt
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying note items with an excerpt in a RecyclerView. Handles UI updates for note display, swipe actions, and search query highlighting.

methods.name: NoteViewHolderWithExcerpt
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with view binding and a note click listener.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Displays swipe action indicators on the note item, toggling views and background color based on swipe direction.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder UI elements, including note status, category, favorite, and search highlight.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns the view that is swipeable, used for swipe gesture handling.
